A design ceiling does not establish installed or operating quantity.
An untyped delivery percentage does not establish MW, buildings, racks, accelerators, or workload capacity.
Unknown means not established by the cited evidence; it does not mean zero or absent.
A fact applies only to its stated scope; highlighted geometry does not transfer it to other assets or phases.
A design or engineering reference is not proof of the site's as-built condition.
A product specification does not establish the site's selected configuration or operating point.
Keep power rates and energy totals on one explicit, matching averaging interval.
Do not convert power to compute without matching hardware quantity, measured power, workload efficiency, and system boundaries.
A derived scenario is not a site estimate; missing site inputs must stop the calculation.
